evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking changes. The PR adds two new entries to server_models.json and adds architecture names to the allowlist header. Existing models, CLI commands, and APIs are unaffected.
evidence.documentation: PR author checked 'Documentation is not affected by this change.' The change adds model entries to server_models.json which is consumed at runtime; no API spec or user-facing docs need updating.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The author reports running both models with Vulkan, so the path has been exercised. No separate human release-critical verification is needed.
evidence.post_approval_commits: The PR had two commits by @sawansri. The first approval from @fl0rianr came at 2026-11-05T18:48:19Z. Both commits predate the approval (committed 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-05). No commits were added after approval. Zero post-approval churn.
evidence.review: One substantive approval from @fl0rianr (state: APPROVED, submitted 2026-11-05T18:48:19Z). No inline review comments. A Coderabbit bot review was also filed (COMMENTED) but carries no human weight. @fl0rianr's subject areas are GUI, CI, and smart router; the llamacpp / new models areas belong to @superm1 and @pwilkin, so subject-matter expertise on llamacpp model registration was not present in the reviewer pool. The changes are minimal — two model entries in server_models.json and one regenerated header file — which may explain why no dedicated reviewer was needed, but this is still a deviation from the guideline that PRs should have at least one reviewer with subject area expertise.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change adds model metadata (checkpoint URLs, sizes, labels) to a JSON registry and updates an architecture allowlist header. Checkpoint URLs point to HuggingFace paths (LiquidAI/LFM3-*-GGUF). No credential handling, network calls, code execution paths, or supply-chain changes introduced.
evidence.tests: CI checks all pass: build, app-regression-tests, macOS builds, backend-docs-drift, pre-commit, server download registry tests, vendor asset integrity, and llamacpp/sdcpp validation workflows. The PR description includes local testing details — the author rebuilt with llamacpp b12109 (Vulkan), ran lemond, and verified chat, reasoning, tool-calling, and vision modalities on both models. ctest results for llamacpp_systemone, HfVariantsTest, HfUpdateCheckTest, and GfxArchGatingTest are reported as passing. No tests weakened or deleted.

subject: Add LFM3-1.7B and LFM3-VL-2B (#4044)
summary: Adds LFM3-1.7B-GGUF (Q4_K_M, labels chat / reasoning / tool-calling) and LFM3-VL-2B-GGUF (Q4_K_M + F16 mmproj, labels chat / reasoning / vision) to the model registry and regenerates llamacpp_architectures_generated.h to cover b12109 pins, which #4057 left stale.
verdict_reason: Straightforward model registry addition with local testing, all CI checks passing, and no post-approval churn.
